column1: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A COUNCIL TO BE

column2: CALLED AND KNOWN AS THE NATIONAL RESEARCH COUNCIL OF
SRI LANKA FOR THE PURPOSE OF FOSTERING AND SUSTAINING A SCIENCE
AND TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CULTURE AND COMMUNITY IN SRI LANKA
AND FACILITATING RESEARCH PROGRAMMES THAT WILL CONTRIBUTE
TO THE NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT AGENDA, AND TO PROVIDE FOR
MATTERS CONNECTED  THEREWITH  OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-

column2: This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  National  Research

column1: Council of Sri Lanka Act, No. 11 of 2016, and shall come
into  operation  on  such  date  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the
“appointed  date”)    as  the  Minister  may  appoint  by  Order
